member.name: E:XansTools.Patching.DamageReactionFacilitator.OnPlayerDamageTaken
member.summary:
This event fires when a player takes any sort of damage.
It contains the attack responsible for the damage as well as the body part that it hit. For more specific body parts, the includes the collider that was impacted.
This event fires twice! Pay attention to the phase parameter, which indicates if this event has fired before or after the attack occurred. Receivers can modify the incoming attack parameter to change values like its damage. Note that the original game method does changes to the damage and so early receivers (which execute before the game runs its code) will not see things like damage bonuses from headshots.
